content: Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Niti luli kame ni myambela, kwaali anjili aimanine bano awo katamba okufa konji abasa mone omubuso wa Nyambe abasa wiye ni maata wawo.”
Okufutuka kwa Jesu

Cwale munyima no maywaa mutanu ni limweya Jesu sebeli oshimba Pitolosi, Jakobo ni Jowani ni kwaatwala ba lilundu no kuleba , oko ano kaikala omboci mi abana kwaliketa Jesu, sebeli ofutuka balubala woo,
mi eikumango yaye sebeli ifutuka eino likena onene mi kakwisa omunu sotwesa okuyowisa esikumango saye nji sitende elikena ngeeso.
Cwale sebeli amona Eliya ni Moshe aamba ni Jesu.
Cwale Pitolosi sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Labbi, esi no kuwaba kwaaci ninji tuikalelele okuno, tuyake eitebule yaatu, esinjili sitende sowe, esinjili sa Mushe, esinjili sa Eliya.”
Abo kasi kulimuka esi no kwamba kakuli kame ana kucila onene.
Cwale elikumbi sebeli liiya ni kwafuka, cwale eliywi sebeli liyupahala mu likumbi elyamba nji, “Woyo ya mwanange ni singa mumuyupe!”
Ababo abana kwaliketa kasi kumona aanu ana kwimana noo konji Jesu yomboci.
Kono abana shetumukanga okutunda ba lilundu, Jesu sebeli walaela nji alese okwambela omunu eyi ana mono, konji enako sainguke Omwana no munu kwaafu.”
Cwale sebeli ateula etaba eyo mu micima yoo, nu kwaambota nji okwinguka kwaafu iikene eyi italusa?”
Mi sebeli amwibanguta nji, “Iikene aiyeti no mulawo aba amba nji Eliya yoso ku tangeta okwiiya?”
Jesu sebeli waatambula nji, “Eliya kame afanene okwiiya oweli nji alukise einu yonje. Cwale iikene aba ku n̄olilwe nji Omwana no Munu kame fanene okuyandisiwa onene ni kukaniwa?
Kono kame ni myambela nji, “Eliya nakwiiya mi nakutenda einu yonje kwa yonyene omo ana kusingela okwiyateteta omo in̄olelwe eyaye mu man̄olo.”
Jesu Yobalisa Ondumbana no Mebo no Kwakena
Mi cwale abana kukeela kwa iyetwa aye sebeli amona aanu no kupula na iyeti no mulawo akanana noo.
Cwale ababo aanu no kupula abana kumona Jesu, sebeli akomoka onene ni kumwitukela okamukeeta.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wibanguta aiyetwa aye nji, “Iikene eyi muna kanananga noo?”
Mi omunjili mukaci no aanu no kupula sebeli otambula nji, “Mwiyeti, kame nina liti mwanange kwa wene, kakuli kame akwite emebo no kwiiba katwese okwamba.
Aba imulemena booshe kame imukwiseta banji ni kulita olufulo ku kanwa ni kukweca amaeo ni ku kukutela. Kame ninambele aiyetwa owe nji aitundise kono na kwangwa okwitundisa.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Anyi olusika no kwapumena, kame sani ikale nanyi enako ikuma babine? Kanako ikuma babine eyi samuni yupisise? Komulite ondumbana kwa mene.”
Mi sebeli alita ondumbana kwa Jesi. Cwale emebo aba ina ku mona Jesu, ababo sebeli imukwiseta banji ni ku tundu olufulo ku kanwa.
Jesu sebeli wibamguta sitaye ndumbana nji, “Ba nako no kukuma babine yotoma eyi mebo no kwiiba?” Mi sebeli otambula nji, “Okutundelela kuwa nukana waye.
Etinako no kupula emebo kame imukwesetenga mu meyi ni mulilo nji imwibae. Kono nji kame utwesa okutenda esinjili otuyupele amakeke mi otutuse.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Nji kame utwesa! Einu yonje kame itwisahala ku munu woyo oli ni tumelo.”
Ababo sitaye omwanuke sebeli okuwa ni kwamba nji, “Kame nili ni tumelo kono icana, onituse nji niikale neyi no kupula”

Cwale Jesu abana mona nji aanu no kupula akeile kwa yonyene, sebeli okalimela emebo no kwakena, ni kwamba nji, “Wene emebo no umumu ni ususu, kame ni kulaela nji, otunde mwa yonyene mi olese okuukela mo kame.”
Cwale emebo no kwiiba sebeli ikuwa ni kumukwiseta ku makondo, emebo no kwiiba sebeli itunda. Cwale ondumbana sebeli osiyala kanyi omunu no kufa, cwale anu onje sebeli aamba nji, “Wafakale.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli omulema ku lyooko ni kumutusa okwimana, mi sebeli oimana.
Cwale Jesu abana kwingena mu ndoo, aiyetwa aye sebeli amwibanguta ku nyonga nji, “Cwale iikene aci aba tuna kwangwa okutundisa emebo eyi no kwiiba?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli waambela nji, “Eyi mebo no mushobo ou kaitwesiwa okutundisiwa feela konji okulapela.”
Jesu Yoamba Kame eyi no Lufu Lwaye
Cwale Jesu na iyetwa aye sebeli asiya eso sibaka nikubita endila no Galileya. Mi Jesu kasi kusinga nji aanu alimuke,
kakuli kame ana kwiyetanga aiyetwa aye ni kwambela nji, “Omwana no munu mbabekiwa mu maoko no alume amwibae, mi abasa mane okwibaiwa, munyima no maywa aatu mbainguka kwaafu.”
Kono kasi yupisisa eyi ana kutalusanga, mi sebeli acila oku mwibanguta.
Woyo no Kuneneba Onene Anyine?
Cwale Jesu na iyetwa aye sebeli aiya mu Kapenamu, cwale yo ikalile mu ndoo, Jesu sebeli waibanguta nji, “Iikene muna kanananga mu ndila?”
Kono aiyetwa aye sebeli aondoka, kakuli kame anoku kananisanga nji cwale munene ni anyine bano.

Cwale Jesu sebeli oikala banji ni kwisana ano kukwana likumi na yiili ni kwamba kwa onyene nji, “Nji omunjili kame asaela okutenda uyu no weli, kame afanena okutenda ono mamaneneno ni kutenda omubika kwawo onje.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli oshimba omwanuke ni kumulita mukaci koo mane ni kumwambeka ba maoko aye ni kwamba nji,
“Woyo yonje sotambula omwanukana mumweya kwaa anukana mu litina lyange na tambula mene, mi yonje sonitambula, kasi tambula mene, kono kame ana tambula woyo onani tumu.”
Woyo yonje Uulwa Okutulwisa ni Wetu
Cwale Jowani sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Mwiyeti, natu mono omunu ona tundisa amadimona mu litina lyowe, mi natu mukanisa kakuli kasa wetu.”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba nji, “Kamufanene okumu kanisa, kakwisa omunu otwesa okutenda etimakazo mu litina lyange kame nji munyima aambe amaywi no kwiiba kwa mene.
Kakuli omunu yonje woyo uulwa okutulwisa ni wetu.
Niti luli kame ni myambela nji omunu yonje somiba ekomoki no meyi nji munwe kakuli kame mupumena mwa Kilesite mbatambula omupuzo waye.
Emiliko Mulibaka no Sibi
“Cwale mumweya nji kame atenda esino kwiiba kwawo apumena kwa mene, nji atende esibi, mba kwikala wino nji omunu woyo amunungelele eliwee linene luli mu ndingo ni kumuyumbela mu liwate.

Nji elyoko lyowe kame liku tendisa eino kwiiba, olipatule kakuli esiwa kwa wene nukaingena mu mooyo ni lyooko limweya, kasanji okaingene ni maoko ayilii nu ukayumbelwa mu liangalilo, omulilo no kwaabwa.
Omo kaifi emibila yoo, nomo no kwatima omulilo.
Mi simba nji elikondo lyowe kame likutwala mukutenda ouyi, olipatuleko, ouwa nu okaingena mu mooyo woli ni likondo limweya, kasa nji oikale ni makondo ayiili nji oka yumbelwe mu liangalilo.
Omo kaifi emibila yoo, ni mulilo no kwatima.
Mi nji elitiyo lyowe kame likusaeseta nji otende eino kwiiba, olitundisemo, ouwa nuukaingena mu mubuso wa Nyambe ni litiyo limweya, kasa nji ni miyo ayiili nuka yumbelwa mu lyangalilo.
Omo emibila yoo kaifu, nomo no kwaabwa omulilo.
Omunu yonje mbaka lungiwa ni mulilo (kanyi esitabelo aba sina lungiwa omungwa.)
Omungwa ni wakuwaba kono nji waamuba kale okuwaba ngasibine sausetwe okumamata kwawo kame? “Mwikale kanyi omungwa muno mwanyi mi mwikale ni kozo kwaa kwenu.”
